Our Glimpse

Indological India is an A Trust Registered Under The Indian Trust Act 1882 founded by S.K.Pathak (His dedication towards the common man propelled him to start various initiatives to help people of all stature. He is fervently leading a devoted team with a massive vision to continue to serve the masses across the country through his humanitarian endeavours. This includes providing state-of-the-art healthcare, education, employment, saving mothers and children, promoting peace, planting trees and technology advancements.

Our Focus Area

• Swasth Bharat (Health)
• Pledge To Palnting Trees (Afforestation)
• Siksha (Education)
• Vishwa Kalyan (By Yajna)
• Bhartiya Sanskriti (Indian Culture)

What We Do?

The causes we target to maximize our impact. Our most successful and sustainable campaigns and activities fall within these areas, through global grants and other resources. We serve our efforts in the following areas

Plantation

Join us in creating a greener world by planting trees and protecting the environment for future generations

Education

Empowering underprivileged children with education to build brighter futures.

Support Women

Providing care and support for pregnant women to ensure healthier lives for mothers and babies

Health Care

Promoting accessible healthcare to build healthier and stronger communities

Help Little Hands

Extending a helping hand to nurture and uplift young lives in need.

Grow Local Economy

Empowering communities to drive sustainable growth and strengthen the local economy.
